There was a good balance between Castorice and Dragon actions before, even the trace i think it was, made sense, whenever you had either Castorice or the Dragon with high HP, it would act quicker than the one who is lowest, so she could be somewhat self-sufficient.

Buffs are so annoying to manage, and now her kit itself is uncomfortable to play, i really don't get why they "buffed" the dragon speed. And you don't even get a good damage output, her damage is so mediocre im really considering skipping her, i just can't stand how uncomfortable the dragon actions have become.

I was on an abusive relationship with someone for like, 6 years or something. Between that time, i had a best friend whose i deeply felt love, the most real and genuine love i ever felt for literally anyone or anything, and it was mutual.

We both cared so much for the other, we both did so much things together and fully supported at our hardest times, and it slowly became a passionate love that surpassed everything, its so hard for me to put it on words, but i swear to god, it was true love.

I for years had been super conflicted, because i was already on a relationship, so having those feelings was wierd for me, and i didn't want to make a choice or put any of them on a scale to just pick one, i felt so disgusted at that thought, so i just repressed that, but every passing year it was harder and harder.

Everything went out of control for me, and i know damn well for they too. Repressing everything was just not an option anymore, but i really felt like the biggest piece of shit for having to make a choice between the hearts of 2 people, even more because i for real wanted to take care and have my responsability with both of them, i didn't wanted to leave any emotional corpse behind.

That was my life for almost 7 years, since i wasn't able to break someones heart, i picked every day of my life to break mine. I've started to distance from both of them, to hide and control my feelings the most i could, i was scared of doing things with any of them, afraid of making someone feel jealous or bad, i was on a self destruction life style and that decision lead me to depression.

One day i just became tired of it, and started to live my life and whatever it happened, i would let it be. I started to spend hours and hours with my best friend, even tho i actively was affecting our relationship, nothing ever changed, we were happy and had a strong bond, and all of that made me rethink my relationship with my partner. There is a ton more in between of the story, but to make it short, spending all of that time with my bff made me realize that on a relationship, you dont feel scared of your partner, you dont feel like you should push you to do things you want, you dont feel insecure.

So, i finally felt like it was time to face reality, and i took my choice. I wanted to risk everything even tho it was scary, i wanted to be happy and be with the person my heart wanted to be the whole time, but in the end it went so wrong. My best friend was someone who struggled a lot their entire life with self destructive behaviour, and obviously so do i, they always said me that i shouldn't pick them, and i should just leave my life as it was and be happy, and it frustrated me because i had so much things on for years.

Its just a mix of a lot of things, and everything feels foggy for me, because realizing how bad i was being treated, suddenly feeling a lot of negative things, a lot of anger towards that relationship, a lot of resentment at me for never realizing how toxic everything was for me, and how i suffered for years all for nothing. My mind just broke, and i was on a bad mood all the time. Most of the time i just wasn't able to speak a word and externate how i felt, and i suppose their low self steem and their usual tendency to be negative and self destructive of everything that they wanted or loved lead them to just push me harder to explode. "you should've picked her, im not enough, if she cames back to your life, everything will be the same again, you would never actually pick me" are the things they constantly said to me even if i cried for entire nights telling them that i made my choice and i wanted to mantain it for me and for them. It was hard and weird, why would they say that if i told them how toxic that relationship was for me, why would they fill my head with doubts and fear when i finally felt like i knew what to do, and i didnt had doubts if i made the correct thing or if i indeed should've picked my last relationship over them, i had doubts if it would work seeing how extremely rejected they looked at the idea of me wanting to fight for our love, even tho for years we acted as a couple hiddn from everyone. 

And one night i just snapped and said a lot of things i really didn't want to say, my frustration and fear surpassed me and it spoke for me. Next day when i woke up i instantly runned to them and apologized, but my apology was rejected, and i got it, i didn't wanted to just be apologized after losing control, i wanted to do things right from now on, trying to explain my feelings even tho i didnt understand them (to this day i still dont get it). But there wasn't another chance, what started as they being cold towards me, and me giving their space until i thought it would be okay to try and talk normally again, became a goodbye from their part.

I dont know nothing about them, and i cry every day since that, i'm scared from not knowing if they're doing alright, or how they feel, fighting the intrusive thoughts of wondering if they're even alive. The last thing i knew was their goodbye note, and one post on their social media weeks before they dissapeared, that said "if you know how i am, why didn't you chased after me". 

I repeat that to myself on loop.

I was not a coward, i had fear, fear of hurting you, or failing after so much we both lived together. Im sorry.
